description: Bookmark/Save feature: toggleBookmark server action, BookmarkButton client component, wiring into the home-feed PostCard and the group detail page, the protected /saved page, and the Saved left-nav link. Depends on FEAT-001 (SamplePost.bookmarked, db types, bookmarks table/RLS). (design.md §2.1, §3.1, §3.3, §3.4, §3.5, §3.8.)
steps: In src/app/groups/actions.ts add `export type ToggleBookmarkResult = { ok: true; bookmarked: boolean } | { ok: false; error: string }` and `export async function toggleBookmark({ postId }: { postId: string }): Promise<ToggleBookmarkResult>` following the setReaction control flow (design §2.1): isSupabaseConfigured() guard (return ok:false, never throw); createClient() + getUser() (!user -> { ok:false, error:'Sign in to save posts.' }, NO redirect); isUUID(postId) check (-> 'Not found or not allowed.'); read existing via `.select('post_id').eq('post_id',postId).eq('user_id',user.id).maybeSingle()`; if absent INSERT (on error console.error + return generic 'Could not update bookmark. Try again.'; on success return { ok:true, bookmarked:true }); if present zero-row-aware DELETE via `.delete().eq('post_id',postId).eq('user_id',user.id).select('post_id').returns<{ post_id: string }[]>()` (empty -> { ok:false, error:'Not found or not allowed.' }); return { ok:true, bookmarked:false }. After a successful toggle call `revalidatePath('/saved')`. (The activity-log call for the insert branch is added in FEAT-003; do not add logActivity here.)

Create src/components/BookmarkButton.tsx (design §3.1): a 'use client' component modeled on ReactionBar. Props { postId: string; initialBookmarked: boolean; disabled?: boolean }. useState(initialBookmarked) + useTransition; on click when not disabled/pending optimistically flip, call toggleBookmark({ postId }), set to r.bookmarked on ok else revert. Render one small icon button with a decorative aria-hidden bookmark glyph, aria-pressed={bookmarked}, aria-label 'Save post'/'Saved — remove bookmark'. When disabled render the button disabled with inert styling and no action. Muted tokens only (text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary, active text-accent, focus-visible:ring-accent).

In src/components/dashboard/PostCard.tsx (design §3.3): import BookmarkButton; in the engagement row after the comment control add `<BookmarkButton postId={post.id} initialBookmarked={post.bookmarked} disabled={!post.isReal} />`. No layout/token changes beyond adding the button.

In src/app/groups/[id]/page.tsx (design §3.4): APPEND bookmarksRes as the 5th Promise.all element (keep the existing four names), extending destructuring to [mediaRes, commentsRes, reactionsRes, authorsRes, bookmarksRes]. 5th entry: `user && postIds.length ? supabase.from('bookmarks').select('post_id').eq('user_id', user.id).in('post_id', postIds).returns<{ post_id: string }[]>() : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as { post_id: string }[] })`. Build `const bookmarkedSet = new Set((bookmarksRes.data ?? []).map((b) => b.post_id));`. Inside the per-post <li> next to <ReactionBar> add `<BookmarkButton postId={post.id} initialBookmarked={bookmarkedSet.has(post.id)} disabled={false} />` and import it. Only the new control uses muted tokens; do NOT rethemethe rest of the page.

Create src/app/saved/page.tsx (design §3.5): protected Server Component following src/app/profile/page.tsx. Env guard -> <SupabaseNotConfigured/>; getUser(); if(!user) redirect('/login'). Fetch bookmarks newest-first `.from('bookmarks').select('post_id, created_at').eq('user_id', user.id).order('created_at', { ascending:false }).returns<{ post_id: string; created_at: string }[]>()`. If ids.length===0 render muted empty state ('Nothing saved yet.') and skip further fetches. Else fetch posts `.in('id', ids).returns<Post[]>()` and author profiles `.in('id', authorIds)` where authorIds = Array.from(new Set((posts ?? []).map(p => p.author_id))); join in memory iterating bookmark (newest-first) order and skipping any post RLS dropped. Render each entry with PostBody (clickable links), the author display name, and a Link to /groups/{groupId}. No reaction counts. Muted tokens throughout.

In src/components/dashboard/LeftSidebar.tsx add a new <li> for Saved: `<Link href='/saved' className={linkNavClass}>` with a new BookmarkNavIcon SVG matching the existing iconClass/stroke style. Do not change the sidebar container styling.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with no type or lint errors.

toggleBookmark on an unsaved readable post returns bookmarked:true and creates one row; a second call returns bookmarked:false and removes it; signed-out returns ok:false (no throw, no row); env-absent returns ok:false (no throw); an unreadable post returns an error-shaped result without a row.
BookmarkButton renders on real home-feed posts and group-detail posts with aria-pressed matching state, toggles optimistically and reverts on failure, and is disabled/inert on isReal:false posts.
/saved redirects signed-out users to /login; signed in it lists exactly the user's bookmarked posts (body with clickable links, author name, link to owning group), with a muted empty state when none.
A Saved item appears in the left sidebar and navigates to /saved.
The Bookmark button uses only muted theme tokens and has an accessible label.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\Projects\AidPal and confirm no type/lint errors.
Run `npm run test` and confirm all tests pass.
Manually confirm toggleBookmark is exported, the group-page heterogeneous ternary + typed empty fallback compile, and the Saved link renders in LeftSidebar.
findings: Symbols now available to later features: `export type ToggleBookmarkResult = { ok: true; bookmarked: boolean } | { ok: false; error: string }` and `export async function toggleBookmark({ postId }: { postId: string }): Promise<ToggleBookmarkResult>` in src/app/groups/actions.ts. It mirrors setReaction: isSupabaseConfigured guard (ok:false, no throw), getUser (!user -> {ok:false,error:'Sign in to save posts.'}, NO redirect), isUUID(postId) guard, read via .select('post_id').eq.eq.maybeSingle(); absent -> INSERT {post_id,user_id} (on error console.error('[toggleBookmark] insert') + 'Could not update bookmark. Try again.'; success -> {ok:true,bookmarked:true}); present -> zero-row-aware DELETE .select('post_id').returns<{post_id:string}[]>() (empty -> 'Not found or not allowed.'; else {ok:true,bookmarked:false}). Both successful branches call revalidatePath('/saved'). IMPORTANT for FEAT-003: the logActivity('bookmarked') call still needs to be added to toggleBookmark's INSERT branch — it was intentionally NOT added here. New client component src/components/BookmarkButton.tsx: 'use client', props { postId: string; initialBookmarked: boolean; disabled?: boolean }, useState+useTransition optimistic flip with revert on !ok, aria-pressed, aria-label 'Save post'/'Saved — remove bookmark', muted tokens (text-text-secondary/hover:text-text-primary, active text-accent, focus-visible:ring-accent). Wired into src/components/dashboard/PostCard.tsx (after the comment control, disabled={!post.isReal}) and src/app/groups/[id]/page.tsx (next to ReactionBar, disabled={false}; group page Promise.all is now a 5-tuple [mediaRes,commentsRes,reactionsRes,authorsRes,bookmarksRes] with bookmarkedSet). New protected route src/app/saved/page.tsx (env guard -> SupabaseNotConfigured; getUser; !user -> redirect('/login'); bookmarks newest-first, in-memory join with posts+profiles preserving order, PostBody with clickable links, author name, Link to /groups/{group_id}, muted empty state 'Nothing saved yet.'). LeftSidebar gained a Saved <li> (new BookmarkNavIcon SVG) linking to /saved via linkNavClass. build + test both clean (54 tests pass).
